note: ids are never reused; 1-127 official, 128-255 custom. Every effect takes a palette: palette 254 = colour 1 -> 2 -> 3, 255 = Effect default: the effect's default palette, or its own colours when default_palette is "own". colors = how many of c1..c3 the effect uses, color_slots = their labels by position (null: that slot is unused); speed / intensity: true when used; palette_slots / palette_note (the ESPHome catalogue): the colour slots it still uses while a palette is chosen, and what the palette colours; the labels say what they do; custom1 / custom2: null or a label. A retired id would stay with retired: true. V407 catalogue: ids 37-114 and palettes 31-42 added 2026-10-22 (design data under "design").

effects.name: Solid
effects.summary: One colour; fades smoothly to another (the transition).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid end to end along the strip, standing still.

effects.name: Breathe
effects.summary: The colour swells and fades like breathing.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip breathes in and out as one.

effects.name: Colorloop
effects.summary: The whole strip cycles through the hues.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the whole strip cycles through the palette; Saturation still whitens it.

effects.name: Rainbow
effects.summary: A rainbow moves along the strip.
effects.intensity_label: Size (128: one rainbow per strip, doubling every 32)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette moves along the strip at the rainbow's pace.

effects.name: Palette
effects.summary: The chosen palette moves along the strip.
effects.intensity_label: Size (128: one palette per strip, doubling every 32)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs along the strip and scrolls slowly.

effects.name: Colorwaves
effects.summary: Slow, ever-changing waves of palette colour.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette sweeps back and forth along the strip in waves of brightness.

effects.name: Pride 2015
effects.summary: Animated, ever-changing rainbows (not palette-based).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the bright waves run through the palette instead of the rainbow.

effects.name: Sinelon
effects.summary: A dot sweeps back and forth, trailing a fading tail.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the swinging dot slowly cycles through the palette (about 11 s a round).
effects.origin: FastLED DemoReel100 sinelon (Mark Kriegsman, MIT), tail computed instead of faded

effects.name: Twinklefox
effects.summary: Twinkling holiday lights that fade in and out.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a palette colour, a new one each time it lights.

effects.name: Colortwinkles
effects.summary: Pixels light up in random palette colours and fade away.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each twinkle takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Candle
effects.summary: The whole strip flickers like a candle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette laid along the strip flickers as one flame.

effects.name: Candle Multi
effects.summary: Every pixel flickers on its own like a candle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: every pixel flickers on its own, in its colour of the palette laid along the strip.

effects.name: Aurora
effects.summary: Drifting curtains of northern-light colour.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: which of the two drifting curtains leads picks the palette colour.

effects.name: Blends
effects.summary: A smooth rippling wash of the palette's colours that drifts along.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette ripples back and forth along the strip and drifts through.

effects.name: Flow
effects.summary: Zones that each show the palette, flowing in turn in opposite directions.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each zone shows the whole palette, neighbours flowing in opposite ways.

effects.name: Fire 2012
effects.summary: Flames rising from the start of the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the heat runs through the palette, coolest to hottest.

effects.name: Gradient
effects.summary: Colour 1 to colour 2 to colour 3 across the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs across the strip instead of colours 1-2-3, repeating and scrolling as set.

effects.name: Pacifica
effects.summary: Gentle blue-green ocean waves.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the waves take the palette's colours, dark troughs to bright crests; the whitecaps stay white.
effects.origin: FastLED Pacifica (Mark Kriegsman, Mary Corey March), MIT

effects.name: Sunrise
effects.summary: A slow wake-up: dark, red, orange, warm white.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's start to its end as the sun rises.

effects.name: Sunset
effects.summary: The wake-up backwards: warm white to dark, and it stays dark.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each pixel moves from the palette's end back to its start as it sets.

effects.name: Glitter
effects.summary: A palette backdrop with short sparkles.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette drifts slowly along the strip, twice over; the sparkles stay Sparkle.

effects.name: Meteor
effects.summary: A meteor with a shimmering tail runs along the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the head takes the palette's last colour and the tail runs back through it to the first.

effects.name: Fairy
effects.summary: Sparse, soft, slow twinkles like fairy lights.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each slow twinkle takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Plasma
effects.summary: Smooth overlapping waves through the palette.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: three moving waves add up to pick the palette colour along the strip.

effects.name: Noise
effects.summary: Drifting smooth noise through the palette.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: slowly drifting noise picks the palette colour along the strip.

effects.name: Running
effects.summary: Waves of colour 1 on colour 2 run along the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the waves carry the palette along the strip; the troughs go dark.

effects.name: Ripples
effects.summary: Raindrops on a pond: soft rings spread out and fade.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each ring takes a random palette colour.
effects.custom1: Rain (how many of the drops fall; 0: none)

effects.name: Wipe
effects.summary: One colour wipes over the other along the strip, then back.
effects.intensity_label: Hold (0: none, 255: three quarters of the cycle)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: with Colours 128 and up, each wipe brings a new palette colour.
effects.custom1: Colours (0-127: Colour 1 and 2 alternate, 128-255: a new palette colour each wipe)

effects.name: Stripes
effects.summary: Hard stripes of colour 1 and colour 2 move along the strip (candy cane).
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the stripes take the palette's 16 colours in turn, hard-edged as ever.

effects.name: Bulbs
effects.summary: A string of coloured bulbs; the colours hop along it.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the bulbs step through the palette by Colour step; the colours hop along.
effects.custom1: Bulb size (share of the spacing, 128: half)
effects.custom2: Colour step (64: a quarter of the palette)

effects.name: Lava Lamp
effects.summary: Big soft blobs of palette colour drift and merge.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the three blobs take colours a third apart, turning about once a minute.

effects.name: Mosaic Drift
effects.summary: Fixed adjoining tiles that slowly melt from one colour to the next.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each tile melts from one random palette colour to another.

effects.name: Silk Weave
effects.summary: Two broad ribbons of light slide through each other and turn pearly where they cross.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each ribbon carries the palette along its length, the two half a palette apart.

effects.name: Canopy Shade
effects.summary: A pale wash with soft leaf-like shadows that breathe and lean a little.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the wash is the palette laid along the strip; the leaf shadows darken it.

effects.name: Opal Facets
effects.summary: Fixed glass-like facets in palette colours; a pearly reflection rolls across each one.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each facet takes a random palette colour.

effects.name: Quiet Landings
effects.summary: One to three soft pearls rise and fall in arcs and touch down without a trail.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the pearls take the palette's colours at its start, a third and two thirds.

effects.name: Daylight Arc
effects.summary: A whole day in slow motion: a soft sun climbs along the strip, the light warms from dawn red to clear daylight, back to dusk and a dim moonlit night.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the day walks the palette, from its first colour at night, dawn and dusk to its last at noon.
effects.custom1: Start time of day (0: midnight, 128: noon)

design.cpu_class: light (~40 cycles/px: one gaussian from a table, one colour-temperature lerp)
design.white_use: RGBCCT: the sun's colour temperature drives WW/CW (about 2200 K at dawn to 5000 K at noon), RGB only adds dawn and dusk reds and the night blue; RGBW: the white part of the daylight goes to W; RGB: mixed whites. With 24 h and a start time the hub could keep it in step with the real clock.

effects.name: Kelvin Drift
effects.summary: Slow, gentle waves of white that drift between warm and cool along the strip, like daylight moving through a room.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the slow waves drift through the palette instead of warm and cool white; Centre sets where on the palette they swing.

design.cpu_class: light (~25 cycles/px: two slow sines give a colour temperature per pixel, one table lookup)
design.white_use: Made for white strips: RGBCCT drives WW / CW directly with RGB off; RGBW uses W plus a light RGB tint for the warm and cool ends; RGB mixes the whites.

effects.name: Cloud Shadows
effects.summary: Sunny light with soft cloud shadows drifting across in two layers at different speeds; the cloud edges glow a little brighter.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the clouds colour the light, clear sky in the palette's first colours and thick cloud in its last, shadows darker.

design.cpu_class: medium (~120 cycles/px: two layers of 2-octave 1-D value noise, parallax offset)
design.white_use: Sunlight is mostly white: W on RGBW with the shadow tint on RGB; on RGBCCT lit parts lean WW and shadows lean CW (shade is cooler).

effects.name: Ember Bed
effects.summary: A bed of glowing coals: every pixel pulses its own slow heat with dark cracks between, and now and then a spark lifts off, drifts a few pixels and dies.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each coal glows through the palette by its heat, from near its start to its end.

design.cpu_class: light (~40 cycles/px: per-pixel phase oscillator + palette lookup; sparks splatted on top)
design.white_use: W off on RGBW (keeps the deep reds); RGBCCT adds warm white at up to 20 % under the hottest coals for depth, never cool white.

effects.name: Shoreline
effects.summary: A beach seen from above: waves wash up the strip with a white foam edge, leave the sand darker and wet, and slide back again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the sea runs through the palette's first half from offshore to the waterline, stretching with each wave, the sand through its second half along the beach; the foam is the sea, paled.
effects.custom2: Sets (every few waves one reaches further)

design.cpu_class: light (~50 cycles/px: swash front as a damped run-up and backwash, wetness per pixel dries slowly)
design.white_use: Foam uses W (RGBW) or CW (RGBCCT); dry sand adds a little WW; water stays RGB.

effects.name: Tide Line
effects.summary: A sea edge creeps up the strip over minutes and slides back with a bright foam fringe at its edge; sand it covered stays dark and wet, then dries pale again.
effects.intensity_label: Reach (how far up the strip the tide comes)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the sea runs through the palette's first half from offshore to the tide line, stretching with the tide, the sand through its second half along the strip; the foam is the sea, paled.
effects.custom1: Chop (small waves riding the tide edge)

design.cpu_class: light (~30 cycles/px: edge distance + wetness decay + 3-colour blend)
design.white_use: Foam and dry sand carry the white: RGBW renders them on W (sand warm-tinted by RGB); RGBCCT uses cool white for foam and warm white for dry sand; RGB blends.

effects.name: Night Sky
effects.summary: A deep-blue night with fixed stars of different brightness and colour that twinkle gently, a faint Milky Way band and now and then a slow shooting star.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: every star and shooting star has its own palette colour, over a dim sky in the palette's colours along the strip.

design.cpu_class: light (~35 cycles/px: star positions, colour and magnitude from a hash of the index, no state)
design.white_use: White and blue-white stars use W / CW; orange stars use WW on RGBCCT; the sky stays RGB.

effects.name: Moon Path
effects.summary: Moonlight on a lake: a still bright moon at one point and a long broken, shimmering reflection stretching away from it along the water.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the reflection runs through the palette from the moon to the far end of the strip, the water is the same colours, dim.

design.cpu_class: medium (~60 cycles/px: two noise samples per pixel for the broken reflection)
design.white_use: Moon and its glints go on W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT); water stays a deep RGB blue.

effects.name: Firefly Sync
effects.summary: Fireflies drift over a dark meadow and blink; their blinks slowly fall into step until the whole field flashes together, then drift apart again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the meadow runs through the palette along the strip; each firefly blinks in the colour where it floats, over the same colours very dim.
effects.custom1: Coupling (how fast they fall into step)

design.cpu_class: light (48 particles; each nudges its blink phase toward the flock's mean phase, mean-field so O(N))
design.white_use: None: firefly yellow-green stays saturated RGB on every strip type.

effects.name: Rain on Glass
effects.summary: Raindrops land on a window, cling, merge with neighbours and run down when they get heavy, over the soft blurred lights of a city behind.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the blurred lights behind the glass take palette colours from slow noise.

design.cpu_class: medium (~100 cycles/px: blurred palette bokeh behind, each drop is a small lens that magnifies and flips the background under it)
design.white_use: Drop highlights use W / CW; the city bokeh stays RGB, warmed with a little WW on RGBCCT.

effects.name: Pool Caustics
effects.summary: The bright, wandering web of sunlight on the floor of a swimming pool: thin light lines that split, merge and shimmer over blue.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the water takes the first half of the palette, the light lines the matching colours from its second half.

design.cpu_class: medium (~120 cycles/px: three moving sine waves, light focuses where their slope sum is flat, sharpened by a power curve table)
design.white_use: The light lines go to W (RGBW) or CW (RGBCCT) so they look crisp white; the water stays RGB.

effects.name: Bioluminescence
effects.summary: A dark night sea where unseen waves stir glowing plankton: blue-cyan light flares where the water moves, then fades slowly.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the glow runs through the palette along the strip, over a night sea of the same colours kept very dark.

design.cpu_class: light (~40 cycles/px: an invisible wave field excites a per-pixel glow level that decays)
design.white_use: None: the glow stays saturated cyan; RGBCCT adds a hint of CW to the very brightest flares.

effects.name: Waterfall
effects.summary: Water pours down the strip: fast streaks with white foam, a churning pool at the bottom and a light mist rising above it.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the water runs through the palette from the top of the fall to the pool; foam, streaks and mist are those colours, paled.

design.cpu_class: medium (~80 cycles/px: streak noise scrolled fast, foam field with turbulence in the pool zone)
design.white_use: Foam and mist use W (RGBW) or CW (RGBCCT); water stays RGB. Start of the strip = top.

effects.name: Koi Pond
effects.summary: A dim pond: a few koi, each a short soft body of orange, white or black-and-gold, glide along, pause, flick and turn, and send a small ripple when they rise.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each koi takes a random palette colour, its patches a third further on.

design.cpu_class: light (~30 cycles/px: 6 fish bodies + a ripple buffer)
design.white_use: White koi and the white patches of the gold ones use W (RGBW) or a neutral mix (RGBCCT).

effects.name: Ink Bloom
effects.summary: Drops of coloured ink fall into still water, bloom outward, curl and mix their colours where they meet, then the water slowly clears.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the three inks take the palette's colours at its start, a third and two thirds.

design.cpu_class: medium (~150 cycles/px: three 16-bit dye fields, diffusion + slow advection, subtractive colour mix)
design.white_use: Clear water is a faint white on W / WW+CW; inks are pure RGB, so the white fades where ink covers it.

effects.name: Incense Smoke
effects.summary: Slow, curling wisps of smoke that rise, twist and thin out, in soft palette colours.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the smoke's swirling noise picks the palette colour of each wisp.

design.cpu_class: medium (~180 cycles/px: domain-warped noise, one noise field bends the lookup position of a second)
design.white_use: Near-white wisps go to W or a neutral WW+CW mix; tinted parts stay RGB.

effects.name: Dust Motes
effects.summary: A warm beam of light where tiny dust motes float lazily, glinting as they cross the brightest part.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the beam is a band of palette colours from edge to edge that sways with it and slowly slides across it; the motes glint in the beam's colour.

design.cpu_class: light (96 slow Brownian particles, brightness = beam profile at their position)
design.white_use: The beam is warm white: WW on RGBCCT, W on RGBW; glints add short W / CW peaks.

effects.name: Sand Ripples
effects.summary: Wind-blown sand ripples lit by a low sun: bright faces and shaded faces creep slowly along the strip.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the sand runs through the palette along the strip; the ripples stay as light and shade.

design.cpu_class: light (~40 cycles/px: asymmetric sawtooth ripple, wavelength wobbled by slow noise)
design.white_use: Sun-side highlights use WW (RGBCCT) or W; shade stays RGB.

effects.name: Wheat Field
effects.summary: Wind gusts roll across a golden field: bright sheen bands sweep along as the stalks bend, then sway back.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the field takes the palette's first half along the strip and the gust sheen its second half.

design.cpu_class: light (~40 cycles/px: each pixel a damped spring pushed by travelling gust fronts)
design.white_use: The sheen uses WW (RGBCCT) or W; the field colour stays RGB.

effects.name: Petal Fall
effects.summary: Petals or leaves drift down the strip, fluttering and catching the light as they turn, and settle softly at the bottom.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each petal takes a random palette colour and keeps it in the pile.
effects.custom2: Settle (pile up at the end; 0: none)

design.cpu_class: light (40 particles with sideways sway; brightness pulses as each one turns; Autumn palette = falling leaves)
design.white_use: A petal facing the light gets a short W glint; the petals and background stay RGB.

effects.name: Starlings
effects.summary: A murmuration against a dusk sky: a dense flock swoops along the strip, stretches thin, bunches up, splits and joins again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the sky runs through the palette along the strip, brightest at the horizon glow; the birds stay dark silhouettes.
effects.origin: own (flocking rules after Reynolds 1987, public algorithm)

design.cpu_class: medium (160 birds: 1-D flocking with cohesion, alignment and separation on index-sorted neighbours; a density buffer darkens the sky)
design.white_use: The dusk sky uses WW (RGBCCT) or W; the birds are dark silhouettes that take light away.

effects.name: Town at Night
effects.summary: Distant windows of a small town at night: warm lights switch on and off now and then, one flickers from a TV, and the town slowly goes to sleep.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each window glows in the palette colour of its place along the street, the TV flickers through the palette.

design.cpu_class: light (up to 128 window segments, each with a slow random on/off timer)
design.white_use: Warm windows use WW (RGBCCT) or W plus amber; cool windows CW; the TV flicker is RGB only and stays within one window.

effects.name: Lantern Row
effects.summary: Paper lanterns strung along the strip: each glows warm with its own soft flicker, and now and then one swings gently in a breeze.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each lantern takes its own random palette colour.

design.cpu_class: light (~15 cycles/px: up to 64 lanterns with phase, swing and flicker)
design.white_use: RGBW gives the lantern body ~30 % W so the paper looks lit from inside; RGBCCT uses warm white; the night colour stays RGB.

effects.name: Lamp Conversation
effects.summary: Small steady pools of lamplight pass a gentle brightening to their neighbours, with pauses and occasional replies.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each lamp has the palette colour of its place in the row, a reply glows in the colour of the lamp it answers, the room is them very dim; the colours move on each turn.

design.cpu_class: light
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Wind Chimes
effects.summary: A set of chimes hung along the strip: a passing breeze sets them ringing one after another, each flaring bright and then humming down slowly.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the chimes take palette colours in order along the row.

design.cpu_class: light (~10 cycles/px: 12 chime envelopes)
design.white_use: The strike flare uses W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT), decaying to the tube colour.

effects.name: Plucked String
effects.summary: The strip is a guitar string: it is plucked at random spots and the standing waves ring and slowly die away, coloured by how far each point swings.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the colour follows how far each point of the string swings, the palette's start at rest.

design.cpu_class: medium (~120 cycles/px: 1-D wave equation, 16-bit displacement + velocity, 4 sub-steps per frame)
design.white_use: The fastest-swinging points get a W / CW highlight; at rest the string is a dim palette line.
design.palette_default_hint: default palette 255 = the new 'Iridescent' palette from this file once it has an id

effects.name: Marble Veins
effects.summary: Polished stone: broad soft bands of palette colour with thin bright veins that wander, fork and slowly dissolve as the pattern drifts.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the stone's noise picks the palette colour; the veins glow in Vein.

design.cpu_class: medium (~90 cycles/px: three noise octaves, veins where the sum crosses zero)
design.white_use: Veins on W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT); the stone body uses auto extraction.

effects.name: Silt Settling
effects.summary: Fine coloured grains settle into softly layered banks that occasionally slump into a new arrangement.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the grains take nearby palette colours that drift slowly; the layers keep them.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Velvet Erosion
effects.summary: A matte field slowly develops soft worn patches whose feathered edges reveal a second colour beneath.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the velvet runs through the whole palette along the strip and the worn patches reveal the colour opposite it beneath, still matte.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Glass Memory
effects.summary: Soft touches of light leave long-lived coloured fingerprints that spread, blend and slowly disappear into smoked glass.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: old traces and the dark glass run through the whole palette along the strip; fresh touches glow in the colour opposite.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Dew Necklace
effects.summary: A line of tiny dewdrops gradually feeds a few larger pearls, then quietly redistributes itself into fine beads.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the beads run through the palette along the thread, the pearl hearts the brightest, the thread the same colours dim.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Linen Pleats
effects.summary: Soft lit folds compress at one end of the strip and relax at the other, carrying a gentle crease through the fabric.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette is printed on the fabric, so its colours fold and unfold with the pleats; valleys dark, fold edges bright.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Estuary Locks
effects.summary: Quiet pools fill to different levels, spill a little light into the next pool and gradually find a shared level.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the row of pools spans the palette and each tide sweeps it along, so pools at a shared level form one gradient; the spill carries the fuller pool's colour.

design.cpu_class: light
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Porcelain Kiln
effects.summary: A row of pale ceramic pieces warms in a slow travelling order, holds its glow and cools through rose-grey at different rates.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the heat colours each piece, cold in the palette's first colours and hottest in its last.

design.cpu_class: light
design.white_use: RGB approximates the temperature progression; RGBW uses its fixed-temperature W only to the extent calibration can match the target; RGBCCT crossfades warm and cool white at constant intended luminance, with RGB retaining coloured detail.

effects.name: Morphogen
effects.summary: Living spots grow, split in two and wander apart like dividing cells, then settle into stripes or die out and start again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the pattern's strength runs through the palette, background to bright spots.

design.cpu_class: heavy (~40 cycles/px per step, 8-16 steps per frame: 320-640 cycles/px; two 16-bit fields, double-buffered)
design.white_use: The densest spots get a W / CW highlight; the background stays dim palette colour.
design.palette_default_hint: default palette 255 = the new 'Abyss' palette from this file once it has an id

effects.name: Cyclic Automaton
effects.summary: Random colour noise organises itself into waves that chase each other along the strip, each colour eating the one before it.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each cell state is a palette colour, the states spread evenly round it.
effects.origin: own (cyclic cellular automaton after Griffeath, public science)

design.cpu_class: light (~20 cycles/px: next state if a neighbour within range holds state+1; fade byte per pixel)
design.white_use: None: pure palette colour.

effects.name: Rule Garden
effects.summary: A cellular automaton that grows: each new generation is drawn over the last with a soft fade, so the strip fills with branching, triangular and lace-like patterns that keep evolving.
effects.intensity_label: Seeding (random cells per second that keep it alive)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each new cell takes the palette colour of its birth, drifting over time.
effects.custom1: Rule (0 .. 255, the Wolfram rule; 30, 90, 110 and 184 look best)
effects.custom2: Fade (how long a dead cell keeps its colour)
effects.origin: own; elementary cellular automata (Wolfram), published maths

design.cpu_class: light (~15 cycles/px: 3-cell rule lookup + age)
design.white_use: Auto extraction from the palette colour.

effects.name: Night Traffic
effects.summary: A road at night: white headlights one way and red tail lights the other, with traffic jams that form out of nothing and creep backwards.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the cars run through the palette as they go round the road; headlights and tail lights take opposite palette colours.

design.cpu_class: light (120 cars on a cell road: accelerate, keep distance, random dawdle; tail lights brighten while braking)
design.white_use: Headlights use W / CW; tail and brake lights stay pure red.

effects.name: Marble Run
effects.summary: Glass marbles roll along an invisible hilly track: they race down slopes, crawl up hills, bump into each other and gather in the valleys before the track tilts.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each marble takes a random palette colour with a swirl of a nearby one.

design.cpu_class: light (height map from slow noise, 24 marbles with slope force, friction and elastic hits)
design.white_use: Each marble has a small specular highlight on W / CW; bodies are palette colour.

effects.name: Soap Film
effects.summary: The skin of a soap bubble: swirling iridescent bands drain downward, thin to gold and black at the top, pop, and form again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the film's bands are the palette, by film thickness; the thin top drains to dark.

design.cpu_class: medium (~100 cycles/px: thickness field drains and swirls; colour from a thin-film interference table built at start)
design.white_use: A faint white sheen across the film on W / CW; the colours themselves are RGB.

effects.name: Pendulum Wave
effects.summary: A row of pendulums of slightly different lengths: they swing in and out of step, forming snakes, waves and chaos, then line up again every cycle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each pendulum takes a palette colour by its place, shifting as it swings.

design.cpu_class: light (~30 cycles/px: phase per pendulum = k * (N + i) * t, one sine table lookup)
design.white_use: Bob peaks add W; the background is colour 2.

effects.name: Newton Cradle
effects.summary: Steel balls hang in a row at the middle of the strip; one swings out from the end, clacks back in and the far ball flies out, back and forth with a brief bright flash at each clack.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the row of balls is the palette laid out, one slice per ball, moving on by one ball every swing so each ball shows every colour; the highlights and clack stay white.

design.cpu_class: light (~15 cycles/px: 7 balls, analytic swing)
design.white_use: Balls are chrome: RGBW draws them mostly on W with an RGB tint; RGBCCT cool white; the clack flash is a 1-pixel white blip at most twice a second.

effects.name: Interference
effects.summary: Two light sources send ripples toward each other; where the ripples meet, bright and dark bands stand still, breathe and slowly slide as the sources drift.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the ripples carry the palette outward from both sources and mix where they meet.
effects.custom2: Drift (how fast the pattern slides; 0: standing still)

design.cpu_class: light (~25 cycles/px: two sines + sum)
design.white_use: Where both crests add, the pixel whitens: RGBW uses W for the overlap, RGBCCT neutral white.

effects.name: Prism
effects.summary: A beam of white light sweeps along the strip and fans out into a rainbow as it travels, then folds back into white.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette replaces the rainbow: a beam fans out from the palette's middle colour to both ends, the background glows in it.

design.cpu_class: light (~60 cycles/px: seven spectral bands, each a gaussian offset by its own speed)
design.white_use: The undispersed core is on W / CW, the spread spectrum on RGB, so the white-to-colour split is very visible on RGBW.

effects.name: Sonar Ping
effects.summary: A dark sea where a soft sonar ping spreads out; hidden shapes light up for a moment as it passes, and their echoes travel back to the source.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the ping and the targets run through the palette's first half by distance from the source, the echoes and the dark sea its second half.

design.cpu_class: light (one ring, up to 16 targets, 8 echoes, per-pixel afterglow)
design.white_use: None: ping and echoes are saturated RGB.

effects.name: Thunderstorm
effects.summary: Heavy, dark rolling clouds with rain; lightning flickers inside parts of the cloud with a few short strokes and a slow afterglow.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the clouds run dark through the palette along the strip, shifting as they roll; rain and lightning light them up in their own colour.
effects.custom1: Flash size (0: small, 255: up to half the strip)

design.cpu_class: light-medium (~70 cycles/px: cloud noise, rain streaks, flash envelope over a region)
design.white_use: Lightning uses CW / W for a crisp flash; clouds and rain stay RGB. Comfort: defaults keep flashes local (about a quarter of the strip) and at most one burst every ~5 s; larger flash sizes are flashy.

effects.name: Neon Sign
effects.summary: Neon tube segments strike up one by one with a buzzing flicker, then glow steady with a soft halo, and now and then one tube stutters.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each tube is one palette colour, the palette across the sign; a tube moves on to a new palette colour each time it stutters.

design.cpu_class: light (up to 64 tube segments with a small strike / steady / stutter state machine)
design.white_use: None: neon stays saturated RGB. Flicker stays inside one tube at a time.

effects.name: Sand Pour
effects.summary: An hourglass on its side: grains fall from one end, bounce down the strip and pile up at the other into a heap that grows grain by grain; when it is full the glass flips.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the sand's layers run through the palette in order, mixed with Sand.
effects.custom1: Flip (0: never, the heap melts away; else flips when full)

design.cpu_class: light (~20 cycles/px: 32 falling grains + heap occupancy)
design.white_use: Auto extraction; pale sand goes largely on W or warm white.

effects.name: Domino Run
effects.summary: Standing dominoes along the strip: a push tips the first, each knocks the next with a short bright flash as it falls and leaves a darker lying row behind; then they stand back up one by one.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each domino takes a palette colour by its place, turning Fallen as it tips.
effects.custom2: Reset (0-127: stand up from the end, 128-255: from the start)

design.cpu_class: light (~15 cycles/px: fall angle per domino slot)
design.white_use: The tip flash uses W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT); dominoes keep their colour.

effects.name: Rope Pulse
effects.summary: A rope pinned at both ends: a flick at one end sends a bump travelling to the other, where it bounces back flipped, and bounces again until it dies away.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the rope is the palette along its length, dim; a bump lights it up as it passes, a flipped bump shows the palette backwards, darker.
effects.custom2: Far end (0-127: fixed, the bump comes back flipped; 128-255: free, it comes back the same)

design.cpu_class: medium (~40 cycles/px: explicit 1-D wave equation, two history buffers, 2 sub-steps per frame)
design.white_use: A negative bump shows a darker tint of the pulse colour; W only in a pale pulse colour (auto extraction).

effects.name: Soliton Courier
effects.summary: Compact luminous packets meet head-on, fuse briefly and emerge on the other side with their shapes intact.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: packets from the start take the palette's first half and packets from the end its second half, changing colour as they travel.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB renders saturated colours; RGBW and RGBCCT leave white channels off for these coloured regions, using only a small neutral component in pale accents if the selected colours or palette contain one.

effects.name: Excitable Wire
effects.summary: A spark starts opposing trains of light that collide, extinguish and leave a short dark recovery gap.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: a front starts in the palette's last colour and its fading wake runs back through the rest to the dim resting wire in its first.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB renders saturated colours; RGBW and RGBCCT leave white channels off for these coloured regions, using only a small neutral component in pale accents if the selected colours or palette contain one.

effects.name: Avalanche Loom
effects.summary: Tiny deposits build coloured ridges until one gives way and sends a cascading rearrangement through its neighbours.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the heap's height runs through the palette (a tenth to four fifths of it).

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Orbit Slingshot
effects.summary: Small satellites arc around moving wells of light, speed through close encounters and escape into a new orbit.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each satellite takes a random palette colour.

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Chromatic Sort
effects.summary: Mixed colour chips shuffle past neighbours until the strip becomes an ordered spectrum, then gently scrambles again.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the chips take palette colours spread evenly and sort back into palette order.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Echo Vault
effects.summary: A soft strike sends unequal echoes between invisible walls, leaving bright nodes where returning waves briefly agree.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: strikes take the palette's first half and echoes its second half along the strip, over dark space of the same colours.

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB renders saturated colours; RGBW and RGBCCT leave white channels off for these coloured regions, using only a small neutral component in pale accents if the selected colours or palette contain one.

effects.name: Folded Time
effects.summary: A coloured gesture returns as successively smaller echoes, each replayed backwards inside the previous trace.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each echo sweeps through the palette as it travels, tinted by Present gesture.

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Fireworks
effects.summary: Rockets climb from the start of the strip and burst into showers of coloured sparks that spread, fall back under gravity and crackle as they fade.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each burst's sparks take random palette colours; the rockets stay warm white.

design.cpu_class: medium (400 sparks, ~80 cycles each with drag and gravity, additive sub-pixel splat; ~45 cycles/px on 784 px)
design.white_use: Burst cores and crackle use W / CW; trails stay palette RGB. Bursts are local, no full-strip flash.

effects.name: Collider
effects.summary: Two bright pulses race in from both ends, smash together and burst into sparks and a shockwave in the mixed colour.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each collision takes two palette colours half a palette apart, the sparks fly in the colours between them; the next collision moves on through the palette.

design.cpu_class: light (2 pulses, up to 128 sparks, one expanding ring)
design.white_use: The collision flash and spark cores use W; pulses stay RGB. The flash is local to the crash.

effects.name: Bass Drop
effects.summary: Energy gathers from both ends into the middle, squeezing tighter and brighter, then releases in a shock wave that races outward and leaves a shimmering afterglow; repeats on a beat.
effects.speed_label: Tempo (60 .. 180 bpm, one drop every 4 beats)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the charging ring's colour runs through the palette, tinted by Charge.

design.cpu_class: light (~20 cycles/px: envelope + afterglow decay)
design.white_use: The shock front uses W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT) at full; the charge colour stays saturated.

effects.name: Beat Pump
effects.summary: Palette bands scroll to a set beat while the brightness kicks on each beat and swells back, like club lights breathing with the music.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the palette runs along the strip in bands and drifts; the beat pumps it.

design.cpu_class: light (~25 cycles/px: palette scroll plus one envelope per frame)
design.white_use: Palette colour only; on RGBW the accent beat adds a short W lift. Comfort: the kick is a dip-and-swell (default 40 % depth), never black-to-white; up to 3 Hz at 180 BPM.
design.palette_default_hint: default palette 255 = the new 'Synthwave' palette from this file once it has an id

effects.name: Beat Bars
effects.summary: A fake equaliser: a handful of bars along the strip jump to an internal beat with bass, mids and highs, fall back with gravity and keep a peak-hold dot that drops slowly.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each bar runs through the palette from its foot to its top.

design.cpu_class: light (~10 cycles/px: 16 bar envelopes)
design.white_use: Peak dots on W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT); bars saturated.

effects.name: Disco Ball
effects.summary: Dozens of small bright reflections sweep across a dark room at the same speed, as from a slowly turning mirror ball.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each spot takes a random palette colour, mixed with Spots by Coloured spots.
effects.custom2: Coloured spots (0: white, higher: more palette colour)

design.cpu_class: light (~30 cycles/px: spots from a hashed grid scrolled at one speed, soft edges from a table)
design.white_use: White spots use W / CW; coloured spots and the room stay RGB.

effects.name: Plasma Globe
effects.summary: Crackling purple filaments branch out from the middle of the strip, wander, and reach toward the ends with bright tips.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the filaments run through the palette from the core (its first colour) out to the tips.

design.cpu_class: medium (~70 cycles/px: up to 12 filaments as random walks with jitter, glow summed per pixel)
design.white_use: Filament tips and the core are whiter (W / CW); the filament body stays purple RGB.

effects.name: Energy Blade
effects.summary: A glowing blade ignites from the start of the strip with a humming flicker, clashes now and then in a bright local flare, and retracts.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the blade runs through the palette from hilt to tip; each clash flares in one palette colour.
effects.custom2: Stay lit (0: ignite / retract cycle, 255: always lit)

design.cpu_class: light (~20 cycles/px: blade length, hum noise, clash spot)
design.white_use: The blade core is whiter on W / CW with colour at the edges. Clash flares are local and under 1 Hz.

effects.name: Confetti Cannon
effects.summary: A cannon at one end fires a burst of coloured confetti that flies down the strip, slows, flutters with little brightness wobbles and settles into a sprinkled layer that slowly fades.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each confetti piece takes a random palette colour, kept as it settles.

design.cpu_class: light (~25 cycles/px: 128 particles + settled layer)
design.white_use: W off except for white confetti pieces; RGBCCT channels unused.

effects.name: Pinball Relay
effects.summary: Coloured balls ricochet between shifting bumpers, handing their colour to each bumper before racing onward.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each ball takes a random palette colour that steps on at every bumper.

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Pocket Rave
effects.summary: Separate little clubs of light trade syncopated pulses while a bright accent walks between them.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each club has its own palette colour on the downbeat and the colour half a palette away on the offbeat, the room is them very dim; the colours move on one palette colour a bar.

design.cpu_class: light
design.white_use: RGB renders saturated colours; RGBW and RGBCCT leave white channels off for these coloured regions, using only a small neutral component in pale accents if the selected colours or palette contain one.

effects.name: Zipper Exchange
effects.summary: Two coloured seams interlock tooth by tooth, exchange their colours and unzip into the next arrangement.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the teeth run through the palette along the strip, the two seams in opposite palette colours that swap at each exchange.

design.cpu_class: medium
design.white_use: RGB renders saturated colours; RGBW and RGBCCT leave white channels off for these coloured regions, using only a small neutral component in pale accents if the selected colours or palette contain one.

effects.name: Packet Switch
effects.summary: Bright parcels queue at junctions, split into smaller packets and rejoin with satisfying little gaps.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each packet takes a random palette colour; its split pieces keep it.

design.cpu_class: heavy
design.white_use: RGB carries the complete look; RGBW transfers the calibrated neutral highlight component to W; RGBCCT divides it between warm and cool whites for neutral highlights without adding brightness.

effects.name: Snowfall
effects.summary: Snowflakes drift down the strip in light gusts and pile up into a glittering white bank at the bottom, which melts away now and then.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the flakes run through the palette as they fall and the bank takes its last colours, over a dim night in the same colours.

design.cpu_class: light (150 flakes with gusts; the snow bank is a fill level with glitter)
design.white_use: Snow uses W (RGBW) or CW (RGBCCT); the night sky stays RGB. Winter / Christmas.

effects.name: Icicle Drip
effects.summary: Icicles hang at fixed points: each glows pale blue-white, a drop swells at its tip, then falls along the strip and splashes into a short sparkle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the ice runs through the palette from the root down, so a falling drop walks the palette to its last colour at the splash.

design.cpu_class: light (~15 cycles/px: fixed icicles + 16 drops)
design.white_use: Ice and drops on W with a little blue RGB (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT).

effects.name: Tinsel Garland
effects.summary: A garland of tinsel with baubles spaced along it: a travelling light makes the tinsel glint in little flashes as it passes, and each bauble shows a round highlight sliding across it.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each bauble gets a light palette tint (about a fifth) over Bauble.

design.cpu_class: light (~30 cycles/px: hashed glints under a travelling light window)
design.white_use: Glints on W (RGBW) or warm white (RGBCCT); tinsel body is an RGB silver/gold tint plus ~20 % W.

effects.name: Ribbon Unwrap
effects.summary: Little wrapped gifts wait along the strip, then their gold ribbons loosen to reveal jewel-coloured interiors.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each gift's jewel inside takes a random palette colour.

design.cpu_class: light
design.white_use: RGB approximates warm highlights; RGBW transfers only their calibrated neutral component to W; RGBCCT sends that component mostly to warm white, preserving coloured edges.

effects.name: Haunted Hall
effects.summary: A dim orange-and-purple corridor lit by uneasy candles; a cold blue draught passes and makes them gutter, a pale ghost drifts through, and once in a while a pair of eyes blink in the dark.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: each candle gets a faint palette tint (about a seventh) over Candle.

design.cpu_class: light (~20 cycles/px: 32 candles, 2 ghosts, 4 eye pairs)
design.white_use: The ghost is dim W (RGBW) or cool white (RGBCCT); everything else saturated; no bright flashes.

effects.name: Champagne
effects.summary: Golden fizz: tiny bubbles stream up from the bottom, speed up as they rise and pop in a sparkle at the surface.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the glass runs through the palette from the bottom to the surface and the colours slowly rise through it; the bubbles rise in full light and pop in the surface's colour.

design.cpu_class: light (200 bubbles, buoyancy with a little wobble, pops spawn short glints)
design.white_use: Bubbles and pops use W / WW; the wine stays golden RGB. New Year.

effects.name: Countdown
effects.summary: A bar of light drains along the strip over the last seconds, pulses on each tick, and at zero the whole strip erupts in fireworks and glitter for a minute before settling to a slow golden sparkle.
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the finale's firework sparks take random palette colours.
effects.custom2: Then (0: stay in golden sparkle, 128: loop, 255: go dark)

design.cpu_class: medium (shares the Fireworks engine during the finale)
design.white_use: Bar and sparkle on W or warm white; the zero moment is the one full-strip white flash (300 ms), then fireworks.

effects.name: Heartbeat
effects.summary: A realistic heartbeat: a soft double pulse (lub-dub) swells from the centre of the strip and relaxes, in a slow rhythm you can set; warm rose by default.
effects.intensity_label: Spread (how far from the centre the pulse reaches)
effects.palette_note: With a palette: the pulse runs through the palette from where it starts outward, resting dim in the same colours.

design.cpu_class: light (~10 cycles/px: envelope + distance)
design.white_use: W off (stays rose); RGBCCT: warm white only through a pale rest colour (auto extraction).
